req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that after all tasks are deleted, a GET request to /tasks/ should return an empty list. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases. The positive test will ensure that deleting all tasks results in an empty list. The negative test will check the behavior when attempting to delete a non-existent task. The boundary test will verify the behavior when deleting the last remaining task.

tests.name: test_delete_all_tasks_positive
preconditions: At least one task exists in the system
actions: Delete all tasks one by one
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to ensure there is at least one task
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201

# Get all tasks
response = client.get("/tasks/")
tasks = response.json()

# Delete all tasks
for task in tasks:
    response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task['id']}")
    assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify all tasks are deleted
response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == []

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_task_negative
actions: Attempt to delete task with ID 9999
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found error is returned
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to delete a non-existent task
response = client.delete("/tasks/9999")
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 9999 not found"

tests.name: test_delete_last_task_boundary
preconditions: Exactly one task exists in the system
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a single task
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201

# Get the task ID
response = client.get("/tasks/")
tasks = response.json()
assert len(tasks) == 1

# Delete the last task
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{tasks[0]['id']}")
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify all tasks are deleted
response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json() == []
